clock.input_sampling: write controls and data are sampled immediately before the active edge

reset.bypass_while_asserted: disabled because a simultaneous write is not legal

acceptance.write: we sampled high at a rising edge while rst is low

read_semantics.normal: rdata_a and rdata_b independently expose the currently stored words at their read addresses
read_semantics.same_cycle_bypass: while rst is low and we is high, each matching read port immediately exposes wdata before and after the committing edge
read_semantics.nonmatching_port: continues to expose its addressed stored word

transition.reset: all stored words become zero; simultaneous we is ignored
transition.write: only the word at waddr becomes wdata

initial_state: Stored words are unspecified until a reset edge. Trusted verification begins with reset.
liveness_boundary: No future write or read-address progress is required. Formal Core contains only safety properties.
